fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Identifier for this weapon config (the port ships ONE: the machine gun, infinite ammo).

fields.name: fireMode
fields.title: Fire mode
fields.description: hitscan = instant ray (the player machine gun); projectile = a spawned travelling round. The player gun is hitscan.

fields.name: baseFireRate
fields.title: Base fire rate (s)
fields.description: Seconds between shots before attack-speed multipliers. combat.gd BASE_FIRE_RATE 0.089 (~11.2 rounds/sec at 1.0x).

fields.name: baseDamage
fields.title: Base damage (per-shot roll midpoint)
fields.description: Per-shot base damage rolled randf_range(DAMAGE_MIN 3.0, DAMAGE_MAX 5.0) before any multiplier; midpoint 4.0. combat.gd DAMAGE_MIN/DAMAGE_MAX.

fields.name: maxRange
fields.title: Max range (m)
fields.description: Furthest distance the hitscan ray reaches. combat.gd MAX_RANGE 100.0.

fields.name: headshotMult
fields.title: Headshot multiplier
fields.description: A head shot quadruples the rolled damage. combat.gd HEADSHOT_MULTIPLIER 4.0 (the live player-path value).

fields.name: critMult
fields.title: Crit multiplier
fields.description: A crit doubles the rolled damage. combat.gd CRIT_MULTIPLIER 2.0 (mirrors PlayerStats.crit_multiplier / BASE_CRIT_MULTIPLIER).

fields.name: critChance
fields.title: Base crit chance (0..1)
fields.description: Probability a shot crits before Crit-stat points. PlayerStats.BASE_CRIT_CHANCE 0.25 (+0.20 per Crit point, clamped 1.0).

fields.name: damageChain
fields.title: Damage chain (teaching field)
fields.description: The ordered multiplicative stack the per-shot damage passes through in combat.gd before round() is applied EXACTLY ONCE. All entries are identity (x1.0) when their condition is unmet, so a grounded still point-blank body shot is unchanged.

fields.name: projectile
fields.title: Projectile type
fields.description: When fireMode is projectile, the projectileType this weapon spawns. Null/unset for the hitscan machine gun.
